Go Concurrency & You

Goroutines are cheap and fun. Use go f() to start one today.

Read the official docs and the channels guide.

Why channels?

  • Communicate by sharing memory
  • Wait for work to finish
    • With sync.WaitGroup
    • Or with a done channel

Steps

  1. Start the worker
  2. Send jobs
  3. Close the channel

Don’t communicate by sharing memory; share memory by communicating.

func main() {
    ch := make(chan int)
    go func() { ch <- 1 }()
    fmt.Println(<-ch)
}
